svg.title: Market risk desk dashboard, limit-first variant (synthetic mockup)
svg.desc: Static 1280 pixel desktop mockup of screen 1 of a Java market-risk dashboard, organised so that risk versus approved limits is the primary question. It shows VaR 99 percent 1 day at 4.82 million USD against a 6.50 million limit (74 percent utilisation, within limit), Expected Shortfall 97.5 percent 1 day at 5.41 million with no limit configured, an approximate VaR 99 percent 10 day figure of 15.24 million derived by square-root-of-time scaling and explicitly not limit-monitored, and 4 backtesting exceptions over 250 days in the Basel green zone. A page-wide method banner states historical simulation with a 501 observation window and an empirical unsmoothed distribution. A 60 day backtest chart plots daily profit and loss against the VaR and Expected Shortfall thresholds with two exceptions highlighted. A component table lists reconciled additive component VaR summing exactly to the desk total, with the diversification benefit reported separately and never netted into components. Limit states are shown as first-class values including one sub-limit breach on credit spread, four components with no sub-limit configured, and one metric where a limit is not applicable. All figures are synthetic and labelled as such.
